scope: Conditional cost-composition theorem only; modular-operation and extended-GCD polynomial bit bounds are explicit hypotheses. Excludes array allocation/indexing, rectangular postprocessing, external-tree integration, curve coverage, and end-to-end ECDLP expected time.
statement: The complete Bird ZMod inverse has an explicit conditional bit-work bound: its determinant, adjugate, and scaling use at most 4(n+1)^6 + 4(n+1)^4 + n^2 charged modular ring operations, plus one separately charged scalar inverse.
